variants.headline: Colony openly defies its charter
variants.sub: Open defiance of the charter is taking place in {colony}.
variants.body:
The colony is openly defying its charter. The defiance is established; a particular punishment or response is not. An assessment of {target} should distinguish the political and legal question posed by that stance from an invented account of what the home world has done in reply.

Open charter defiance is a legal and political fact, not a complete statement of operating consequences. Business readers should avoid assuming that a sanction has followed or that an established rule has simply ceased to exist. Assessment requires a distinction between the stance taken and the response actually reported.

We judge {target} adversely. Defiance demands a serious account of responsibility, and a bold stance should not be allowed to shelter inadequate political judgment behind the attraction of its own gesture. Reliable assessment begins with particulars rather than a politically convenient assumption.
